question: What kind of warranty do GCM Netting Solutions offer on your pigeon net installations?
answer:
At GCM Netting Solutions Chennai, we stand firmly behind the quality and durability of our pigeon net solutions. We offer a comprehensive warranty ranging from 3 to 5 years on all our pigeon net installations. This warranty specifically covers material defects and our installation workmanship, ensuring your peace of mind and long-term protection against avian nuisances.

Our nets are crafted from high-density polyethylene (HDPE), renowned for its exceptional strength and durability. They are also meticulously UV-stabilized, meaning they can withstand Chennai's intense sunlight and varying weather conditions without degrading, fraying, or losing effectiveness over time. As a leading provider of high-quality safety nets in Chennai, our expert team ensures meticulous and secure installation, adhering to the highest safety standards for maximum effectiveness.

Please note, the warranty does not cover damage caused by external factors such as severe weather events, accidental damage, or any unauthorized tampering with the nets. Should you experience any issues covered under your warranty, simply reach out to us. Our dedicated customer service team is always ready to assist you promptly. For more details or to schedule your professional pigeon net installation, please call us directly at +91 99123 99224. We are committed to your satisfaction and the longevity of our products.
